dedupe_keys.name: eurostat farm statistics microdata integrated farm statistics scientific use files

description: Farm-level microdata from the EU agricultural census and farm structure surveys. The Eurostat page says farm microdata have been collected since 1990 through the census every ten years and sample surveys, that microdata for 2010, 2016 and 2020 are available for research, and that the 2020 census covered over 9 million farms. The scientific use files group or micro-aggregate variables such as legal personality, manager age, livestock, labour, standard output, animal housing, manure, crops, irrigation, tillage and crop rotation to protect confidentiality. Access is free of charge for research purposes through Eurostat's microdata access procedure. Coverage is EU member states and some other European countries. Caveats: variables are perturbed or grouped, so exact farm values are not available. For simulation it gives farm structure, irrigation and livestock by holding, to build agent-based models of farm responses to drought, floods or input shortages. A related catalogue record is the Eurostat agricultural census grid.
